title.zh: 日本金融厅批准稳定币贸易结算实证实验
title.en: 日本金融厅批准稳定币贸易结算实证实验

current_state.zh: Japan's Financial Services Agency approved the fourth PIP support case, a joint proof-of-concept by TradeWaltz, NTT Data, Mizuho, MUFG, SMBC and MUFG Trust Bank to test stablecoin-based settlement of trade transactions and clarify related legal issues, starting September 2026, with results and regulatory conclusions to be published.
